The two harmonic sums produce the claimed logarithmic coefficient. The bundled checker independently confirms the exact membership criterion and asymptotic slopes at finite cutoffs.

value.rationale: The primary paper uses momentum-band density to compare the magnetic lattice with discrete Hofstadter behavior, and its half-flux case visibly contains narrow and wide high-energy structures. The exact decomposition exposes a previously unquantified \(k^{-1}\)-scale gap at every half-integer momentum and converts the leading density statement into a sharp second-order law. This distinguishes two competing resonance mechanisms and gives a natural quantitative convergence rate rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
